title: Mixed Event — Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show!

meta.Event: Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show!
meta.Outline: After successfully wrapping up their ambassadorial performances, Wonderlands×Showtime is preparing to put on a New Year's show at the new and improved Wonder Stage. Unfortunately, Lion Dance Robot seems to be feeling a bit under the weather...

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Hah hah hah hah!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “After ten years of toil, I, Tsukasanosuke Tenma, have at long last discovered the greatest treasure under the sun!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“However, this box is enormous...
If it is filled with gold, then I would not have to work another day as long as I live.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Heh heh heh. So, let us see what is inside!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Now, Robo-Nene!
Flash your lights!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Engaging.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Ah, such a heavenly light...!
This must be a treasure of immeasurable wealth!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Oh, my eyes... I was afraid that I had gone blind... Hm?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Waaaaaaaaah!!!
Wh-What is this?!”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: “CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP. CHOMP CHOMP...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Hm...?!
'Be at ease, young one'...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“How is this possible?!
All I hear is him chomping, but I can understand exactly what he is trying to say...!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “What in the world are you?!”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: “CHOMP. CHOMP CHOMP.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Huh?! 'I am a deity'...?!
What are you saying...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Yes, this shrine does indeed have a long history... But to think that you are its patron deity!”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line:
“CHOMP, CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP.
CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Uh... 'It is understandable that you do not believe me'...? An odd and boastful creature you are...”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: “CHOMP!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Gwah...!
His thoughts keep penetrating my head...!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“What?!
'I shall grant you a wish if you are able to make the people of this land smile'...?!”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: “CHOMP.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “A-Anything...? Including gold, money and giant castles...?!”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line:
“CHOMP!
CHOMP...!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: One more time, Robo-Nene!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Miku, Len, just like we practiced! Get ready to raise the castle backdrop on three!
One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Len
rows.Line: Now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Wh-What?! A castle just appeared in the distance?! You truly are a deity...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Then, I know!
To make my dream of having a castle of my own a reality, I shall make the people of this land smile...”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: “CHOMP!”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And so, Tsukasanosuke embarked on a journey with the Lion Dance Deity to perform for people all across Japan♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Woof woof woof!
It's great to see so many people visiting the shrine today♪”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “But this Lion-Dog's starting to get bored of being stuck here working. It'd be great to go out for a walk and go somewhere else for a change...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Come one, come all!
All are welcome to see the traveling performer!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Hm? Is he a traveling performer?
Does that mean he's gonna do something for all of us?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“That sounds fun!
Oh, I know! I should ask to see if I can join him...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“*Yawn*
Another beautiful day...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I am so glad that I was born a Snake Deity. All these humans bring me offerings without me having to lift a finger.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“However, they are all so scared of me that they refuse to stay to listen to my singing...
*Sigh*”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Come one, come all!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “See the traveling performer's amazing show! Woof woof! Huh...?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Hey, Tsukasanosuke!
I see a Snake Deity over there!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“A Snake Deity?!
That is quite a rare find... Hm...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Hehehe... If she were to join us, our performance should attract just that much more attention! Lion-Dog, we must capture her!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Yeah!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Wh-What?!
Capture?! N-No, stay away!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“Oh, what is this?
I exited the shrine to see what was going on with the village...”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Come one, come all!
See the traveling performer's amazing show!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “S-Singing is all I promised to do...!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Well, it is nice to see a troupe like this for a change.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “It may actually be worth this shapeshifting fox's time to join in on the festivities.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“Let us see how it goes...
Hello there, traveling performer. Do you have a moment?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Hm?”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The Lion Dance Deity led the human, Lion-Dog, Snake and Fox as they set out to put smiles on the faces of people all across Japan, from north to south, by performing a show that they had never seen before.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Before they knew it, ten years had passed, and they were able to put on a New Year's performance that made the entire audience smile from ear to ear.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “We... We finally did it...!”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: “CHOMP CHOMP.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Hah hah hah! You can say that again!
I, Tsukasanosuke, am the most dashing man in all of Japan after all!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Now, my divine friend!
I believe it is time for you to grant me my wish!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“First, my castle!
Naturally, I shall call it, Tenma Castle!”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: “CHOMP...”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “What do you mean, 'I cannot'...?”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: “CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“What...?
'Despite being a deity, my powers waned significantly while I was sealed away, so I am limited to producing projections of castles'...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Wh-What is the meaning of this...?!
I had your word. It is why I worked so hard all these years! Was it all a lie?!”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: “CHOMP...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Bah... You liar!
Begone with you...!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Wait, no!
Don't go!”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: “CHOMP...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“*Sob*
Were these past ten years all for naught...?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Please cheer up, Tsukasanosuke!
Your castle... I can't really do anything about that...”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “But I had a lot of fun these past ten years thanks to you.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“So what if you did...?
You had fun. Good for you. But I have nothing to show for my efforts...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Are you sure?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I have been alive for 200 years, but these past ten years have definitely been the most fun...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “All good things eventually wither away. Castles are no exception. However, the time we spent together... That will likely never fade.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“Yes, I agree.
I too have been alive for quite some time...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “But I would not trade seeing people all across Japan smile for any amount of gold.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Tsukasanosuke, you may not have been rewarded with a physical treasure. However, to those who you've made smile, you mean everything to them...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“And those smiles we saw...
That became our treasure.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Their smiles are our treasure...?
I see...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “And yet, we still have one person left who is not smiling... Well, a deity, not a person...”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: “CHOMP...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“...
I apologize for calling you a liar, my friend.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I could not have attained this treasure on my own. You were the one who made it possible.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “So, thank you for these past ten years.”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line:
“...!
CHOMP!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Huh?! Why are you glowing...?!”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: “CHOMP! CHOMP CHOMP!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “I see. I do not fully understand what is happening, but by bringing back the smiles on everyone's faces, you seem to have regained your powers...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“So much power...!
More power than even the Great Snake Deity!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“W-Wait! A real castle...?!
My wish came true...?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“That's great, Tsukasanosuke!
You finally got the castle you wanted!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “How would you all feel about using this place as a theatre for our performances...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “We can gather people here to do performances for them, and even perform outside from time to time... Would that not be a fun way to put a smile on the faces of the people of this land?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Yeah! I wanna do that!
Let's keep doing shows together!”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: “CHOMP!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Whoa!
Give me a little warning before throwing yourselves at me like that! Hahaha...!”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And so, Tsukasanosuke and his merry group of friends continued to make everybody all across the land smile. The end.
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, excellent dress rehearsal...!
And a wonderful New Year's spectacle!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
Of course it is!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We plan to have some members of the audience participate during the day of, so things should become even more fun.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The audience?! That does sound like fun♪ Break a leg, you guys☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks.
Still, it's been pretty long since we last properly did a show at the Wonder Stage...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, it has!
As sad as it was to hear that we wouldn't be doing any more ambassadorial performances...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's do our best to make everyone who comes to visit the Wonder Stage smile from ear to ear!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No more ambassadorial performances...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hm? Is everything okay, Tsukasa...?
You look like you have something on your mind...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Me?
No, I'm okay. It's nothing...

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line:
CHOMP...!
CHOMP CHOMP! CHOMP...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Wh-What the...?
Why is smoke coming out of Lion Dance Robot all of a sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, he may be overheating because he had to move around quite a lot just now... Which means he might...

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Waaah!
Wh-Why's he chasing after me again?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Don't worry. I made it so his fans automatically cool him while he runs around. He isn't malfunctioning, so he should settle down in a moment.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, so I have to keep running until he does?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, they're playing tag♪
We wanna join!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, let's jump right into it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
W-Wait!
We aren't playing tag!!!
The next day -  New Year's Eve
Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We're back at the Wonder Stage following the conclusion of our ambassadorial performances...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But we haven't been receiving the same sort of stimulation as before.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Of course, I couldn't be happier to be back at the Wonder Stage making the audience smile. This is our home and there's plenty we can still do here.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I want more of those opportunities...
I want to keep growing as an actor.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I could conceivably train with some other troupes to hone my craft... But...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm the troupe leader of Wonderlands×Showtime. I can't just leave because I feel like it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You care deeply about doing your best as a cast member of Phoenix Wonderland and making your own dream come true...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Both things, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?! It's already this late...?!
I need to get to practice!
A few hours later
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And so, Tsukasanosuke and his merry group of friends continued to make everybody all across the land smile. The end.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, our final rehearsal went beautifully. We should be more than ready for tomorrow's performance...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's make it a super happy New Year's for everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, let's!
A happy performance to kick off the new year!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You've been awfully quiet today...
Just yesterday you were running all over the place.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Shall I run a check?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Whoa! You scared me!
Also, check? Check what...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In simple terms, she'll be running a diagnostic check on him to make sure he's functioning properly.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Does that mean she can figure out if Lion Dance Robot's sick...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Understood.
Commencing diagnostic check.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Check complete.
No issues detected.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Really?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Yes.
However, if I were to put my finger on it...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: He seems to be feeling a little down.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?!
Lion Dance Robot's feeling sad?! Why?! Our show's tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, a robot can feel sad...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It could be because our show is tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Lion Dance Robot seemed very happy when I brought him out of storage the other day since he usually only gets to come out and play around New Year's.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I suspect that he's feeling a bit down because he knows that he'll have to go away for a while after tomorrow's performance...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, let's make it so he gets to appear in shows all year round! Not just during New Year's!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, it's so much fun to do all sorts of shows in all sorts of different places!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
True...
As much I'd like to do that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I built Lion Dance Robot with a fairly specific purpose in mind. Unfortunately, his functions are limited, so it may be difficult to make him more versatile.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?!
But...

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (In other words, Lion Dance Robot would look very out of place if he were to perform in a show that's not about New Year's...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He may be a robot, but it does seem like he wants to be in more shows...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He may even stand to gain quite a lot if we were to somehow make that possible for him...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, why don't we try performing in a variety of different places outside of the Wonder Stage?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
A wide variety of places?!
That sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You mean starting now? How are we gonna do that? It's New Year's Eve, and we need a way to transport Lion Dance Robot and Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'd also have to receive permission to perform wherever we go. That's going to take a bit of time...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
R-Right... Wait, I know!
Emu, can't we ask your brothers for some help?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
They could help us get permission to perform!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, hang on... They're gonna be busy attending all these New Year's parties and stuff, so they might not be able to help...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Grr...!
Then, we just have to find someone else who can...
Oh, are you all done rehearsing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hi, Sis!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Sis...? Emu, is she your big sister?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I do remember hearing that she has an older sister...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's nice to meet you all.
I'm Emu's big sister, Hinata.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: You must be Tsukasa, Nene and Rui. I've been meaning to meet all of you for quite some time now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
L-Likewise!
We are honored!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Anyway, Sis, what are you doing here? Did you need something?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, I was actually hoping to use your New Year's show as reference for something.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our show? As reference...?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Yes, I'm studying how to make it so children can have more fun while learning.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: As it turns out, I'll be doing some field training at a preschool and putting on a little performance for the children there.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: So, since you're very popular with children, I was hoping to have them see your show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. Thank you for explaining.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Not a problem. But I seem to have missed my opportunity since you've already finished practicing...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: At the same time, I'm glad I came since I got to overhear a lovely conversation.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: You were just talking about doing shows in various different places, no? I'd like to help you with that, and I can drive if need be.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
S-Sis...!
Thank you! This is so wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A-Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Of course! Not only do I want to see your show, but I'd also love to help out.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you very much!
Then, we happily accept!
New Year's Day - Just before sunrise
Beach

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy New Year!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh... Isn't it great to be able to face the sea and say that to bring in the new year?! It's like we're experiencing the peak of our youth!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah, totally!
This is gonna be so memorable☆>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... But it's so cold...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Winter by the sea usually is...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <We can't really tell how cold it is. I hope you girls have a way to stay warm...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We do. We made sure to bring hand warmers and hot tea, so we should be able to stay warm until the sun rises.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Also, I was really surprised to hear that you were all going to the beach on New Year's Day.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You suggested it, right, Saki?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
I watched this show where a group of friends went to the beach to see the first sunrise, and I thought it was such a beautiful scene!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Geez, you always get influenced by those kinds of things...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <At the same time, you only get one chance per year to do something like this, right?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'm sure it'll be a nice experience...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
If only SEKAI had seas and oceans.
Then we'd be able to do this together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We're more than happy that we get to be with you like this. We can even hear the waves just fine.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Eep... The wind's so cold...!
Let's see how much time is left until the sun's supposed to rise...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Looks like we'll still be waiting for a bit...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I feel like you girls got there really early.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...!
We left the convenience store because we saw all these people gathering. We thought that meant we'd be in for an amazing sunrise, but...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <They all have fancy cameras set up, so I have to think that they came here early to claim a good spot.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I think you're right.
Since we have some time, why don't we head back to the convenience store for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, it's just... I thought I heard a familiar voice...

Oh, excellent!
The sun looks like it's going to come up at any moment!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
...!
Th-That voice...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Wait a second... That's Saki!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means... You must be here with Ichika and company!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ts-Tsukasa...?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What's he doing here...?!
Uh oh... Miku, you and the others need to hide.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Okay, hiding!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm? Hoshino...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, Kusanagi, you're here too...!
Hang on. Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?! Hi, everyone!
Happy Newonderhoy Year!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! What a happy coincidence! And a wonderful way to start the new year!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is it really a happy coincidence, though...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, shh!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll be performing in a show here later. It'd be nice if you all stopped by to watch.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
A show?
H-Here?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We wanted to do some shows in a bunch of different places during New Year's, and my big sis is driving us around♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Why don't we all go together?
You too, Asahina. How does that sound...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I suppose I can stay until I hear from my family...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, Mafuyu, you gotta hear this!
Li'l Bro said he and his team also saw Tsukasa's show!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It was a wonderful, happy show to welcome in the new year.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, seeing that Lion Dance Robot wandering around startled a lot of us...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Lion Dance Robot...?
We saw that show too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, Shizuku, you did?
Talk about a big coincidence!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, let's talk more about it over at the cafe! C'mon, you guys!
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Are you okay, Ms. Yoisaki?
You're carrying quite a lot, so maybe we should stop and take a break.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry, Ms. Mochizuki...
I didn't mean for this to happen when I asked you to go shopping with me...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're going over to your friend's house this afternoon for a party, yes? If you're pressed for time, please feel free to go...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's okay.
I still have plenty of time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: More importantly... I hope you find a nice place in your father's hospital room for that mini mochi set that you just bought.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Me too...
We always have it on display during New Year's, so I hope he likes it...

Huff... Huff...
Maybe I should stop here... Plus, it's freezing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh...?
That looks like... Kanade?! Honami?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wh-What are you two doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
We were just out shopping...
What were you doing just now, Ena? Running?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Wait, I can't tell them that I'm running because I ate too much during the holidays and how Akito's poking fun at me for it...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: R-Remember that show we saw yesterday by that troupe from PXL...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seeing that made me want to be more active... Haha...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
PXL...?
Are you talking about the show that Emu's troupe did?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh?
Wait, Ms. Mochizuki, did you also see it?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um... Yes, but not at the mall.
I saw it at the beach...

rows.Speaker: Kanade & Ena
rows.Line: The beach?!
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, to summarize...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: After doing a show at the beach, Tsukasa and his troupe did another one on top of a mountain and then at a ski resort...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-That's amazing...!
It's like a surprise tour!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The show itself was really short, but it must've been really hard to pull off something like that...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: At the same time, it's must've been really fun! A concert tour's one thing... But a show tour!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It actually seems like something they'd do...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree!
Oh, Shiho, sorry for keeping you! We know you have a New Year's party to get to...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, don't mind me.
I still have some time until we're supposed to meet up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You two are meeting up with Kiritani and Shiraishi, right? Try not to be late, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
They said that they're already there, so maybe we should get going.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
Oh, Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I nearly forgot to say... Happy New Year!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's go to PXL together again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sure.
And Happy New Year to the both of you.
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Here's to our successful New Year's performances...! Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Rui & Nene
rows.Line:
Cheers!
Cheers.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Robo-Nene, Lion Dance Robot, here's some fresh oil. I know it was a tough schedule, so thank you both for persevering.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was amazed to hear that, aside from the Wonder Stage, you were able to put on shows in 4 other places.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me too! That's what I call a dynamic plan!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Still, are you guys okay?
Don't you feel tired at all?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be honest, I wasn't sure we'd make it through when I first heard about what we'd be doing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I think we were able to pull it off because it ended up being more fun than expected.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
The guests at the Wonder Stage also really loved it—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh nooo!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hm?
Is something wrong, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What do I do?! I slept so well yesterday that I didn't have my first dream!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Your first dream...? Oh, of the new year?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If that's the case, won't the dream you see tonight count as your first for this year?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wait, that counts?!
Then, I'm gonna have a super wonderhoy dream tonight!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A wonderhoy dream... What does that entail?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Uhh, soo... You guys are all gonna be in it, including Miku and everyone...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And we'll put on lots and lots of shows in all sorts of different places like yesterday♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It's very similar to what we just experienced in real life, but it sounds like a wonderful first dream...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I wanna see that dream too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, let's draw it together!
I heard that if you draw what you want to dream and put it under your pillow, you'll actually see it when you sleep!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really? That sounds like fun♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What if we got a big sheet of paper for that?! We could all draw on it and sleep on it afterward!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that means we'll all get to see the same dream♪ Where can we find a sheet of paper like that?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'll help you guys look for one!
Nene, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? W-Wait...!
You don't need to pull me!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. I guess we'll be sleeping directly on top of it instead of putting it under a pillow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That'll be very interesting to see.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Is everything okay, Tsukasa?
You're usually all wound up and ready to go in these situations.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, I'm fine...
I was just reminiscing over what happened yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yesterday?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes.
Asking for volunteers from the audience ended up being an interesting learning experience...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Ichika and the others sang in a way that felt so encouraging. That sort of singing performance is sure to invigorate any audience she sings for.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Hanasato and her group also put on a wonderful performance. Based on how well they interacted with that audience, their shows must be out of this world...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I can't forget Shiraishi and her teammate! I was so moved by the way they sang with so much passion! They certainly know how to please an audience.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(That girl... Yoisaki, was it?
I was completely staggered by how she was able to come up with such a beautiful song on the spot.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (A show requires more than just actors. Everyone, including those involved with sound production, must work together to bring it to life.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Moving forward, I'd like to work more on understanding what kind of music would suit certain scenes better.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I have quite a bit to work on in the future...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But it was a wonderful learning experience!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It was?!
Then, I'm glad☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It was as I suspected...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I was able to make these realizations because I performed with different people at places we normally don't.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Which means I can't let things just be...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Something on the order of our ambassadorial performances may not be possible, but I need to start by asking to perform elsewhere.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (However, this is not something I can decide on my own. I'll need to speak with Emu's brothers first.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes...!
I must do this! For the sake of my dream!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone! We found a giant sheet of paper!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's all draw on it and have ourselves a little nap!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's draw♪
Oh, but what?

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh?
You wanna draw too?

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Having put on a series of successful shows, he seems to be rather motivated.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, I see...!
That's great to hear!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Lion Dance Robot, let us keep putting on wonderful shows together moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line:
CHOMP...!
CHOMP...

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP CHOMP... CHOMP CHOMP...!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
He appears to be very excited.
So excited that he may overheat soon...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, which means he may once again...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! That can only mean...

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nooo!
He's coming after me again!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh no!
Is Tsukasa gonna be okay?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... He's designed to operate on his own, but it's interesting how he always chases after Tsukasa... I'll need to take a closer look at some point...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha! He does look excited!
Let's play a game of tag before we draw♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now is not the time for that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Uhh, Rui...?
Shouldn't you do something?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know.
We wouldn't want our valiant troupe leader to get hurt. Emu, would you mind lending me a hand?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's go save Tsukasa together!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I see another fun and exciting year in the works.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yup☆
I can't wait to see what happens!
